_readme: Owner polls shown on the games.oddvale.com home page. A poll is served and counted only when "approved" is true, and only between opens and closes (UTC dates, inclusive). The owner approves a question by setting approved to true (or by saying so to the agent who commits it). Choices are fixed; ids are lowercase. After editing, redeploy the API (npm run api:deploy) and the site (npm run deploy).

polls.question: Which game should the robots build next?

choices.label: Sift: pour falling sand through parts you place, a new puzzle daily
Teeter: balance hanging mobiles for picky robots, a new puzzle daily
No new game: more levels for the ones we have
